projects.title: Academic Fraud Detection
projects.description: A cybersecurity based research project exploring how machine learning can help identify potentially fraudulent scholarship, internship and academic publication offers.

projects.title: FlagShip — Feature Flag System
projects.description: A Java-based feature-flag evaluation engine focused on rule evaluation, targeting, deterministic percentage-based rollouts and reliable flag evaluation.

projects.title: EnerPeers — Peer-to-Peer Energy Trading
projects.description: A web application where households can trade surplus renewable energy with their neighbours, developed as a university capstone project.

projects.title: Secure Login-Based Encrypted File Sharing System
projects.description: A Linux-based file-sharing system designed around user authentication and encrypted file exchange. Developed an assigned Bash component and contributed project documentation.

projects.title: Apartment — 2D Interior Scene
projects.description: A 2D apartment interior scene created with OpenGL, using DDA, Bresenham's line and midpoint-circle algorithms.
